inventory.summary: The .ring/ directory in kody-w/rapp-canary is the operations center for the RAPP release train (Canary → Nightly → Alpha → Beta → Grail=kody-w/rapp-installer, human-merge only). The pipeline is five operator-run verbs (RUNBOOK.md): (1) DEVELOP — all work branches off canary main, preflight CI runs on every push; (2) PROMOTE — promote_ring.py copies shared Git blobs one parent→child edge at a time (canary→nightly→alpha→beta), preserving each target's ring-owned overlay (.ring/, .github/workflows/) and writing a .ring/upstream.lock.json provenance record; the operator commits/pushes the target; (3) QUALIFY — GitHub workflow test-pre-grail-rings.yml (read-only credentials, exact commits as inputs) unit-tests the tooling then tests all four rings and emits a canary→beta attestation chain as CI artifacts, which archive_attestations.sh copies into git under .ring/attestations/run-<id>/; (4) SOAK — soak.sh renders canary main via render_ring.py and serves it on :7073 with real Copilot auth for days of real usage; device_probe.sh and the Pages-served flight.sh/flights.html additionally give zero-config sandboxed installs on any device; (5) RELEASE — grail_gate.py verify re-downloads the qualification run's attestation chain, validates linkage and payload identity, checks beta main has not moved, recomputes the payload digest from a fresh beta clone, and optionally exports the exact qualified bytes onto a grail feature branch (never commits/pushes); the merge, tag, and push are human, per grail RELEASING.md. Attestation chaining (ring_attestation.py): each ring's attestation contains a payload {repository, commit, tree, shared_sha256} where shared_sha256 is a deterministic SHA-256 over sorted (path, mode, blob-sha256) of every non-ring-owned blob; each child attestation must carry parent:{ring, sha256-of-canonical-parent-JSON} and an identical shared_sha256 to its parent — so the chain cryptographically proves ONE unmodified payload passed every ring, and any rebuild or drift breaks it.
